method: 18 isolated processes, three rotated repeats per fixture/variant. Identical files and explicit file selection, no fabricated diff. Cold index then three analysis samples; projection only in xray variant. Same analysis output hashes required. Process high-water RSS is cumulative, not a per-stage allocation metric. No forced GC; retained RSS is not proof of a leak.
interpretation: All six-file variants reached ~1.29 GiB cumulative peak during the identical post-index 1s idle, before analysis or projection, then current RSS fell to ~63 MiB. Immediate-exit peak comparisons measure different observation durations and are not an isolated X-Ray allocation. This identifies an existing index/runtime cost, not the exact V8/WASM allocator cause. X-Ray still performs source IO and JS projection; small samples do not prove zero cost or a leak. Express is a clean real repository selected by file, not an edited Git-diff performance claim. No renderer/FPS measurement.
